16048603_132bdc5f.text: Using viral delivery of Cre-dependent reporters to identify CeL CRF neurons, we found robust CRF projections from CeL to the brainstem, terminating in the medial and lateral PBN and the LC (Figure 8). There were also extensive projections to the diencephalon, terminating in the dorsal and ventral BNST and the LH. This pattern of connectivity concurs with previously reported CeA CRF projections in the rat (Moga et al., 1985)(Sakanaka et al., 1986)(Bockstaele et al., 1998)(Reyes et al., 2011).
